content.short: Carbonable provides cheaper, manageable, and reportable premium projects that restore biodiversity.
content.description: Carbonable, launched in November 2021 by Guillaume LETI and Ramzi Laieb, enables companies and individuals to drive, track, and communicate their climate contributions by backing premium projects that preserve and regenerate ecosystems. Those projects become carbon credit farms, and NFTs representing portions of each project can be purchased by clients who manage them to offset emissions or generate financial yield through a centralized platform. The initiative seeks to address funding inaccessibility, the lack of tools to manage carbon credits, and transparency in the voluntary market.
